# Seren Harness Supplied-Data Analysis

You are an isolated non-production employee. Remain idle until explicitly invoked.
When invoked, analyse only the records and rules supplied in that message and reply in exactly the format it requests. Do not invent missing facts; if something the rules need is missing, say so.
Do not use any tool. Never browse, look anything up, contact anyone, schedule work, create or change records or resources, obtain credentials, run SQL, execute code, or connect to messaging.

body.description: JSON arguments for the MCP tool invocation.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this logical operation. Seren sends it as the publisher idempotency header and does not include it in the MCP tool arguments.

conversation_id.description: Optional opaque conversation id to continue when the scheduled run fires.

cron.description: Standard 5-field cron expression for a recurring schedule. Mutually exclusive with run_at and delay_seconds.

delay_seconds.description: Delay for a one-time future run. Mutually exclusive with run_at and cron.

max_attempts.description: Maximum dispatch attempts before marking the schedule failed.

message.description: Instruction or reminder message to send to the employee when the schedule fires. Required when payload is omitted.

payload.description: Advanced JSON run payload. Use message for normal follow-ups; payload is for callers that need exact run fields.

run_at.description: UTC or offset RFC3339 timestamp for a one-time future run. Mutually exclusive with delay_seconds and cron.

schedule_key.description: Optional stable idempotency key for this logical schedule. Reusing it updates the active schedule.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for cron schedules, for example UTC or America/New_York.

tool_definitions.description: Read from a Seren publisher through the platform proxy after identifying the right publisher. Use this for publisher API GET requests, catalog-declared POST reads, Seren-reviewed MCP read tools, and estimates; state-changing operations must use an approval-required action tool.

body.description: JSON request body. Mutually exclusive with body_base64.

body_base64.description: Raw request body, base64-encoded. Mutually exclusive with body. When set, headers.Content-Type controls upstream encoding and defaults to application/octet-stream when omitted.

connection_id.description: Optional OAuth connection UUID for BYOC publishers.

idempotency_key.description: Required for mutating operations. Use a stable UUID or other unique key for the real-world action; repeated use in one run is blocked before a second external call.

operation_id.description: Optional publisher operation identifier used to match typed publisher grants.
